name: Early Years
summary: Nursery and Kindergarten. Play, stories, songs, phonics and a lot of talking, all in English. We follow the British EYFS framework.
points: Phonics, maths and literacy in Kindergarten

name: Primary
summary: Cambridge English, Maths and Science every morning. Afternoons are cooking, technology, craft, art, movement and a class called Boredom.

name: Lower Secondary
summary: Years 7 to 9. Cambridge Lower Secondary with subject teachers, plus History, Executive Function, Art of Science and the Maker Space.

name: Upper Secondary
summary: A US diploma or a Cambridge pathway at each student's own pace, with a teacher coaching every block. Plus IELTS, PTE and GED preparation.
points: Personal project and a student-planned trip

name: Global Program
summary: For travelling families. Your child joins a real class, half day or full day, and leaves with a progress report and a certificate.
points: Progress report in the first two weeks
